JUST IN: Transport group MANIBELA is set to hold a three-day nationwide transport strike starting Dec. 9, and may extend beyond Dec. 11, according to MANIBELA Chairperson Mar Valbuena.

In Metro Manila, MANIBELA organizers also launched a one-day transport strike Friday, as a build-up for the nationwide strike set next week.
